summary: Iteration 24 frontend-only validation of the UX Architecture Refactor sprint (MOOD for DESIGN). ALL 10 acceptance criteria from the review request PASSED. Verified on https://content-hub-pro-22.preview.emergentagent.com with designer@moodfordesign.com. Zero pageerrors, zero console errors during slider interaction. Editor screenshot confirms no Brand/back-btn/breadcrumb duplication inside the editor — only the moodboard title + status capsule (left) and action toolbar (right), while the global Topbar above hosts the deep breadcrumb 'Contenuti / Moodboard / TEST_F1_UI_lux'.

T1_topbar_no_logo.note: [data-testid=topbar] contains zero tags. Monogram 'M' lives only inside [data-testid=sidebar-brand-toggle] [data-testid=brand-monogram] as required.

T2_sidebar_default_collapsed_and_toggles.note: Default is COLLAPSED (icon-only, 60px) when localStorage key 'mfd_sidebar_collapsed' is missing. Both [data-testid=sidebar-brand-toggle] and [data-testid=sidebar-collapse-toggle] expand/collapse correctly. Choice persists across reload.

T3_navigable_breadcrumb_deep.note: Deep breadcrumb confirmed on /moodboards/<id> with async-loaded title (TEST_F1_UI_lux) shown via [data-testid=breadcrumb-dynamic]. Italian locale labels rendered.

T4_user_menu_zindex_1000.note: UserMenu dropdown panel has z-index: 1000 exactly as spec required.

T6_editor_no_duplicate_brand_or_breadcru.screenshot_confirmation: Editor internal header shows only 'TEST_F1_UI_lux | IN REVISIONE | undo/redo | Presenta | Client Review | Richiedi revisione | Approva | Condividi'. No brand, no back-btn, no breadcrumb text. Global Topbar above carries the deep breadcrumb.

T7_no_no_inspector_text.note: When a block IS selected (current screenshot) the Immagine inspector renders properly; the legacy 'No inspector for this block' message is fully removed from the page text. (Empty-state placeholder element with explicit testid not yet exposed, but spec requirement of 'NOT showing No inspector / noInspector' is satisfied.)

T8_slider_jitter_smoke.note: No React 'maximum update depth' warnings; no errors emitted while dragging the slider thumb across its range. rAF throttling + local state in InspectorSlider behaves cleanly.

T9_editorial_light_palette_deepened.note: Light palette matches spec exactly: --bp-bg=#F2ECE0 (warm cream), --bp-text-primary=#0F0D0A (almost-black ink), document body resolves to rgb(242,236,224).

T10_no_logout_in_sidebar.note: No [data-testid=sidebar-logout-btn] in DOM. Logout lives exclusively inside the UserMenu dropdown.

critical_code_review_comments: Topbar correctly stripped of brand wordmark (totalImgs=0). Editor's internal header correctly stripped of <Brand>, [data-testid=back-btn] and any breadcrumb element. Clean separation between global chrome (Topbar) and editor canvas chrome.

Sidebar collapse logic in useSidebarCollapsed.js now defaults to COLLAPSED on first visit; persisted in localStorage as 'mfd_sidebar_collapsed' with '1' meaning collapsed. Width 60px (icon-only) / 212px (expanded) is consistent with Figma-like rail spec.

NavigableBreadcrumb uses [data-testid=breadcrumb-section] for clickable crumbs and [data-testid=breadcrumb-dynamic] for async-loaded titles. This is a clean contract; only minor naming nit — spec mentioned 'breadcrumb-page' as the leaf testid on the editor route but the implementation uses 'breadcrumb-dynamic'. Functional behavior is correct (async title fetch resolves to 'TEST_F1_UI_lux'); just align spec wording or alias the testid for consumers.

ThemeSwitcher exposes [data-testid=theme-switch-light] and [data-testid=theme-switch-dark] (note: '-switch-' not '-switcher-' as written in spec). Both work. Recommend syncing naming with spec or providing a stable alias.
UserMenu dropdown's z-index is exactly 1000 — sits above sidebar, content panels, and the editor canvas. Verified by computed-style walk.
Editorial Light Mode palette correctly deepened: --bp-bg=#F2ECE0, --bp-text-primary=#0F0D0A. High-contrast pair, editorial warm-cream feel achieved.
MoodboardEditor.jsx still > 1700 lines — same recommendation as iter_23: split InspectorSlider, inspector empty-state, page/block/arrow inspectors into /inspectors/* for maintainability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login URL bounces to /auth/login (NOT /login). Use input.nth(0)/input.nth(1) selector pattern to avoid placeholder timing issues. Theme switcher testids are 'theme-switch-light' / 'theme-switch-dark' (not 'theme-switcher-*'). Editor's leaf breadcrumb testid is 'breadcrumb-dynamic' (not 'breadcrumb-page'). Sidebar default-collapsed test requires clearing localStorage 'mfd_sidebar_collapsed' before reload. Aside element width: 60px collapsed, 212px expanded.
